- Created netlify/functions/trends.py serverless function

- Created index.html redirect to main visualization
- Updated README with deployment section
- Added .env.example for reference (no vars needed)

Build process:
1. Compile Rust WASM module with wasm-pack
2. Install Python deps (pytrends, pandas)
3. Deploy serverless functions
4. Serve static files via CDN
